# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
platform macos
# window-open
tap id:case-window-open
expect Windows: main
expect Get: true none none
tap id:open
expect Result: same true, main false, parent true, state null
expect Windows: main,first,second
expect Get: true first second
expect In first: main false, parent none, shared 0
expect In second: main false, parent main, shared 0
# One engine renders every window: the app's signals reach them.
tap id:shared
expect In first: main false, parent none, shared 1
tap id:close
expect Result: closed, state null, get null
expect Windows: main
expect Closes: 1
absent In first: main false, parent none, shared 1
covers [nsh/desktop] Window
covers [nsh/desktop] windows
covers [nsh/desktop] currentWindow

# The app closed it: no onOpenChange.
tap id:toggle
expect Windows: main
expect Open: false changes none events none
tap id:toggle
expect Inside inspector
tap id:close

expect Open: false changes false close events none
absent Inside inspector
covers [nsh/desktop] Window

prop id:bar desktop.windowDrag true
